title: Birbal and the Weight of Smoke
moral: With clever thinking, even difficult problems can be solved.

scenes.summary: Akbar asks Birbal to measure the weight of smoke.
scenes.text: One day, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal if he could measure the weight of smoke.
scenes.image_prompt: king asking unusual question in court, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Courtiers believe the task is impossible.
scenes.text: The courtiers laughed and said it was impossible to measure smoke.
scenes.image_prompt: people laughing in court while birbal stands calmly, cartoon

scenes.text: Birbal brought a piece of wood and weighed it before burning.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal weighing wood on scale, cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Birbal burns the wood and weighs the ash.
scenes.text: After burning the wood, Birbal collected the ash and weighed it again.
scenes.image_prompt: burning wood and collecting ash with scale, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Birbal explains the weight of smoke.
scenes.text: Birbal explained that the difference in weight was the weight of the smoke. Akbar was impressed. With clever thinking, even difficult problems can be solved.

story: One day, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal to measure the weight of smoke. While others laughed, Birbal weighed a piece of wood, burned it, and then weighed the ash. He explained that the difference in weight was the weight of the smoke. Akbar was impressed with his clever idea.
